problem: Prove that if \(f\) is continuous on \([a,b]\), \(\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=0\), and \(f(x)\ge 0\) for all \(x\), then \(f(x)=0\) for all \(x\in[a,b]\).
verified_reference: Suppose f(x_0)>0 for some x_0. By continuity, f(x)>=f(x_0)/2 on a nondegenerate one-sided or two-sided interval around x_0 contained in [a,b]. Since f is nonnegative elsewhere, the integral over [a,b] is then strictly positive, contradicting that it is zero. Hence no such x_0 exists and f is identically zero.

problem: Prove that if \(f\) is continuous on \([a,b]\) and \(\int_a^b f(x)g(x)\,dx=0\) for every continuous function \(g\), then \(f(x)=0\) for all \(x\in[a,b]\).

If f(x_0) were nonzero, continuity would make f^2 bounded below by a positive number on a nondegenerate neighborhood of x_0, forcing the integral to be positive. Thus f(x)=0 everywhere.

學生未建立 |c_n x^n| ≤ M q^n 之類比關係，也未引用或構造與收斂半徑相關的有界性；
未說明或陳述「c_n r^n 無界」的推導過程，僅憑「級數在 r 收斂」直接跳到比值判別法是邏輯上的缺漏；
比值判別法的應用缺少對 n→∞ 時比值趨向於 |x|/r <1 的嚴謹驗證，且未說明此比值是否對所有 n 成立或是否能控制 c_n 的行為；
